steps.title: Define App Specifications
steps.description: Establish key requirements for the multi-featured Random Generator application.

steps.title: Configure Android Build Properties
steps.description: Configure build.gradle with correct compile/target SDK 34 and Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2 versions.

steps.title: Setup Android Manifest
steps.description: Write AndroidManifest.xml defining package namespace, launcher activity, system theme, and standard icon.

steps.title: Create Card Design Drawables
steps.description: Create background drawables for modular panels and card elements.

steps.title: Create Control Element Drawables
steps.description: Develop XML custom rounded shapes for text fields, interactive buttons, and accents.

steps.title: Create Coin State Drawables
steps.description: Create high-contrast gold and silver metallic base circular drawables for high-fidelity coin simulation.

steps.title: Design Main Layout Structure
steps.description: Design activity_main.xml layout structure including standard toolbar, horizontal navigation tabs, and content area.

steps.title: Develop Tab Navigation Logic
steps.description: Implement tab click handlers and view toggles within MainActivity.java to switch panels dynamically.

steps.title: Code Single & Multiple Generator
steps.description: Write random generation calculation logic supporting custom bounds, generation count, and unique constraint checks.

steps.title: Build Custom Dynamic DieView
steps.description: Program high-performance custom vector canvas DieView to draw 3D-feel physical dice faces programmatically.

steps.title: Create Dice Roll Simulation
steps.description: Implement interactive rolling sequence with handlers to cycle values dynamically and sum final dice values.

steps.title: Create Coin Flip Animation
steps.description: Program 3D Y-axis rotation animations simulating real physical coin behavior with Head/Tail visual states.

steps.title: Implement Persistent Session History
steps.description: Create local memory state tracking for generation logs and display formatting in scrollable history tab.

steps.title: Building Random Generator
steps.description: Compile and bundle the Random Generator app under verified Gradle environment.
